customer_review_summary: Customers find the swimsuit good-looking and worth the money. The fit receives mixed feedback, with some customers loving it while others note it runs very small.

top_reviews.title: Tummy control!!
top_reviews.body: This is amazing. Truly looks great on you very flattering and definitely keeps my 2 time c-section mom body in check. I wish I would have sized up because I feel it’s a little short in the torso for me. Overall great purchase. Worth the money.

top_reviews.title: Flattering
top_reviews.body: I really love this swimsuit style. My only criticism is the top is not full coverage. Since the back allows for cinching and tummy control adjustability, I sized up (XL) hoping the top would work for me (38DD) but I still had spillover on top and sides. Plus, upsizing gave me a loose fit at the bottom. I'll still enjoy wearing this at home but I wish it was one I could publicly wear because the cut is really flattering. For women with a smaller bra size, it should work fine though.

top_reviews.title: Good looking, short torso
top_reviews.body: This is a good looking suit and seems well made. The color contrast definitely accentuates the curves. It absolutely isn't great for long torso or taller people. I needed something for a vacation and made it work, but I wouldn't have worn it in public. The inserts for the built in bra (and the 'cups/shelf' were well under where my bra should be, but the neckline was high enough that I made it work. There is also no tummy control really. The price is great, so for shorter/regular torso people it should be a great option.

top_reviews.title: Excellent swimsuit
top_reviews.body: Excellent swimsuit; I really liked it, and the fabric is of very good quality.

top_reviews.title: Disappointed with purchase
top_reviews.body: First the fit was amazing. The coverage was great BUT and this is a big "but" the color ran and the white trim is now grayed. The strap at the top has started to loosen threads. One wear and wash (I washed it separately in cold water) and the suit is truly unwearable due to the dingy color. Wish there was a way to return it and get a refund. So very disappointed.

top_reviews.title: This is a long torso bathing suit which it does not specify
top_reviews.body: Nowhere in the title or the sizing does the specify that it is for a long torso! I am 5'1" this is so extremely disappointing! If your product is either tall or petite, it should be specified in the title and the sizing. You should not have to make people scroll all the way down to the 5 million paragraphs you've put in fine print to find out that this bathing suit is, in fact a long torso. Stupid!
